title: Verifiable evaluations of machine learning models using zkSNARKS

bias_targets.methodology: Demonstrating the zero-knowledge verification framework by evaluating a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) trained on the CelebA dataset, allowing an inspector to verifiably analyze the clustering of racial characteristics in the model's latent space.

Discussed as a primary use case for the zero-knowledge proof (zkSNARK) framework, enabling an auditor to perform fine-grained analyses of facial recognition accuracy disparities across genders without exposing private model weights.
